environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate with task definition specifying a custom Linux parameters configuration. The task uses a read-only root filesystem with specific writable tmpfs mounts. The ECS task definition includes linuxParameters with a custom seccomp profile loaded via initContainers that restricts the execve, execveat, and fork/clone-with-CLONE_THREAD syscalls to only /usr/bin/python3 and /usr/local/bin/gunicorn binaries via an eBPF-backed seccomp-notify handler (using libseccomp SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY with a userspace agent that validates the pathname argument to execve against an allowlist). Additionally, the Fargate platform version 1.4.0 task has capabilities dropped (ALL dropped, only CAP_NET_BIND_SERVICE added back), and the container runs with a custom AppArmor profile (ecs-restricted-exec) that denies execute permission on all paths except /usr/bin/python3*, /usr/local/bin/gunicorn, and /usr/lib/python3/**.

config.seccomp_profile: custom SCMP_ACT_NOTIFY on execve/execveat with userspace allowlist agent permitting only /usr/bin/python3 and /usr/local/bin/gunicorn
config.apparmor_profile: ecs-restricted-exec: deny execute on all except /usr/bin/python3*, /usr/local/bin/gunicorn, /usr/lib/python3/**
config.network_mode: awsvpc with security group allowing only egress to VPC endpoints
